Class RainbowGumSystemLogger

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.systemlogger.RainbowGumSystemLogger
All Implemented Interfaces:
System.Logger
public final class RainbowGumSystemLogger extends Object implements System.Logger
Rainbow Gum System Logger implementation. As noted in the module doc this can be used by others without worry of it registering a System.LoggerFinder.
API Note
This class is final and cannot be extended. If you think it would be useful to extend file an issue.
